typography.primary_font: System default sans-serif (San Francisco for iOS, Roboto for Android) to ensure maximum native legibility at small sizes.

visual_enhancers.key_shape: Square-like geometry. borderRadius: 6px for a modern, tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.key_depth: Neumorphic tactile approach: Flat background with 1px solid bottom border/shadow matching the 'key_shadow' color to give physical depth.
visual_enhancers.active_state: Scale down transform (0.95) and slight background darkening on press.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the Settings Modal overlay: backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/60 (Dark) or bg-white/70 (Light). NEVER fully transparent.

components.KeyboardContainer: Absolute positioned view pinned to the bottom. Safe area aware.
components.KeyBase: Pressable component with unified interaction logic (onPressIn, onPressOut).
components.SettingsModal: Bottom sheet or modal displaying keyboard configurations.
components.LanguageToggle: Dedicated globe icon key replacing the traditional comma/emoji key area for quick EN/HI switching.
components.EmojiPanel: Horizontal scroll view or grid view of standard emojis available when toggled.
components.NumberRow: Optional top row of numbers enabled via settings.

layouts.row_staggering: Middle and bottom rows must have dynamic horizontal padding to mimic physical QWERTY staggering.
layouts.key_spacing: Strict 6px gap between keys horizontally and vertically.
layouts.touch_targets: Minimum touch target height of 48px for all keys.

motion.key_press: Use React Native Animated API for a snappy spring animation (scale down to 0.95 on press-in, back to 1 on press-out).
motion.haptics: Integrate 'expo-haptics'. Trigger ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light on key press.
motion.panel_transition: Slide up animation when switching from Letters to Emoji panel or opening Settings.

accessibility.test_ids: Every key MUST have a data-testid (e.g., data-testid='key-a', data-testid='key-backspace').
accessibility.aria_labels: Keys should have accessibilityLabel with the character or action name.
accessibility.screen_reader: State changes (Language switched to Hindi) should be announced via Accessibility API.

icons.usage: Backspace (delete), Shift (arrow-up), Settings (settings), Language (globe), Emoji (smile), Enter (return-down-back)

instructions_to_main_agent: Context: This is an Expo React Native mobile app using .js files.
To use this custom keyboard, you MUST suppress the system keyboard. Set 'showSoftInputOnFocus={false}' on the target TextInputs.
Create a global Context or Zustand store to hold the active input reference, current cursor position, and keyboard settings.
Keyboard Settings Store should include: isHindi (boolean), soundEnabled (boolean), hapticsEnabled (boolean), showNumberRow (boolean), theme (system/light/dark).
Build the QWERTY layout as arrays of strings. Build the Hindi layout mapping corresponding consonants and vowels (Varnamala) across tabs or a shifted layout.
Implement a Custom Key component that intercepts 'onPressIn' to fire 'expo-haptics' and play a system sound if settings permit, then updates the text.
For the Settings Modal, use a Modal component with a blurred dark overlay. Include Switches for Emoji Panel, Sound, Haptics, and Theme.
Ensure the keyboard dynamically calculates key width based on screen dimension divided by 10 (for the top row) minus margins.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Create depth through layered design elements (1px borders, subtle drop shadows). Use glass-morphism effects for overlays with proper blur and semi-transparent backgrounds—NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds over content. Use modern shapes (rounded squares for keys). Every interaction needs micro-animations (scale on press). Ensure UI meets APCA contrast standards. ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid. DO NOT use emojis for icons, use vector icons. Do not use generic centered layouts for the main app UI; align elements logically.
